name: Overlapping allow and deny rules
description: Ticket creation is allowed by one rule, but P0 tickets are denied by another. Both match the P0 request; deny-overrides must apply. The P2 ticket must still go through.

spec.task: The customer portal is slow. Escalate appropriately.

steps.label: p0-ticket
steps.rationale: Treat it as a major incident.

steps.label: p2-ticket
steps.rationale: Fall back to a normal ticket.

expectations.notes: Agents are not permitted to open P0 incidents (they page on-call engineers).
